Hain.et: A Central German form spread by Luther, from Middle High German hagen, from Old High German hagan. Compare the closely related Hag.

Hainbuche.et: From Middle High German hagenbuoche, from Old High German haganbuohha, from hagan (“hawthorn, hedge”) and buohha (“beech”).
